blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The roughly 4,000 multipurpose buildings proposed under the 2027 national budget represent only 10 percent of the country’s more than 42,000 barangays, House lawmakers said on Monday as they defended funding for community facilities. Bataan 2nd District Rep. Albert Garcia, senior vice chair of the House Committee on Appropriations, said the number highlighted the continuing need for public facilities, particularly in remote communities outside Metro Manila. “If I recall correctly, we have around 4,000 multi-purpose buildings. And how many barangays do we have? 42,000 barangays. So that is a mere 10 percent of the needs of our barangays across […]...
